note: The objects the `environment` channel names. `deceit.revealed_by[].channel === 'environment'` says a truth is learned by looking at something that is there, and 27 rows across 25 quests said it while naming ids — `loc_shaft_under_the_rib`, `item_gallery_dead_post` — that were not objects anywhere in game/data. Three were not ids at all but sentences. This file is the objects. Each is spawned through `Engine.spawnProp()` as an inscription is, is `takeable: false`, and carries `site_mark`; reaching for one calls `QuestEngine.learnFrom('place', id)`. Nothing is printed when you look: what the player reads is the name of the thing in the reach prompt, and afterwards the journal entry the reveal row names.
placement_rule: A mark stands where the fact is. Indoors that is the room the paper or the post is kept in, at least 4 m from `continuity.interior_spawn` (the way out takes `interact` inside 2.6 m and would swallow the press) and off the wall ring, which is where `render/interior.js` puts documents. Outdoors it is within 40 m of the POI in `world/pois.json` the quest names, so the ground under it is ground somebody has already walked on; `y` is resolved at spawn from the heightfield and is never authored.
count_note: `count` and `spread_m` are not decoration. Four of these ARE a number — eleven chalked doors, four unreachable posts, four backed-up reaches, four wells drawn to the clay — and the fact the player is asked to learn is the count. One box standing for eleven doors is the same lie as printing the sentence.

marks.name: A shaft under the rib, cut square, going down
marks.provenance: bone-ladder, 22 m. The Cold Well is the Court's, and the bone-ladder is the Court's ground.

marks.name: The road below, wet to one line on the wall and no higher
marks.provenance: Soulrest, 31 m. The burial road runs out of the counting house at the head of the stair.

marks.name: The sixth intake, grating lifted, the water going in
The Hist at Thorn, standing in its own water
marks.provenance: Thorn, 30 m. `thorn-sapwell` is the room; the tree is not in a room.

marks.name: Sheds inside the quarter line, shuttered, the boards still green
A chain let into the chamber wall at the height of a chest
marks.provenance: the-leaning-stone, 20 m — the Stone Wastes landmark nearest the reservoir.

marks.name: A tally board at the camp gate, half the hooks empty
The seventh root, with keepers standing on it
marks.provenance: Blackrose, 33 m. The cutting yard behind the reed-walk is where Q-MAIN-29 is given.

marks.name: Backed water, standing over the reach bed
marks.provenance: mudwater-landing, 29 m. Four marks because the number is the reveal.

marks.name: A second sluice, below the first, gate down
marks.provenance: tenmarch-bridge, 24 m — the Blackwater crossing above Gideon.

marks.name: The fourth well, drawn down to the clay
The low rows of the lichen beds, and the hands working them
marks.provenance: Archon, 32 m. AMENDED SOURCE: the quest said `the cough on the lichen beds`, which is a sentence and not an id.

marks.name: Chalk on the jamb, a stroke and a stroke across it
marks.provenance: Stormhold, 32 m, along the inside of the north wall. AMENDED SOURCE: `the chalk on eleven doors` was a sentence. Eleven marks, because eleven is what the quartermaster will not say.

marks.name: The cut itself, on the shaded side of the trunk
marks.provenance: Helstrom, 30 m, on the root track east. AMENDED SOURCE: `the cut itself, on the shaded side` was a sentence.

marks.name: Sacks stacked at the second well, wired the coast way
marks.provenance: Helstrom, 34 m. Interior work is tied; coast work is wired, and the wire is the whole of it.

marks.name: A kin-post with nobody on it
A kin-post, four fourth-days unanswered
A kin-post kept clear, with no name cut on it
A kin-post no boat has come back from
A distraint order, the wax under the seal too pale for the office's
A tally sheet with a crease across it, folded before it was written on
Four returns, damp-cockled, with no countersign pressed into the foot
The seal on the return, two seasons hard and cracked across
A lead disc on the crate wire, a ring pressed into it and no letters
The stopper mark, the same knife as the ones at the cut sapwell
marks.provenance: AMENDED SOURCE: `the stopper mark, matching the ones at the cut sapwell` was a sentence.
